t: That this Act may be cited as the “Army-Navy Medical Services Corps Act of 1947”.

fable.w: This section only provides the short title of the Act. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision. There is no real tempting reading here; a citation clause has no participatory content.
